However, that multi-year past performance has clearly stalled as trailing twelve-month compounded profit growth has turned negative at -3% [E17] alongside a 1% year-on-year sales contraction [E48]. The bull defends the 0.00% dividend yield [E4] as capital retention, yet that retained value has produced zero cash returns for shareholders while the price-to-book ratio of 1.54x trades at a premium to the sector benchmark of 1.31x [E7]. Finally, citing a 416% 1-year share price surge [E18] only underscores the extreme disconnect noted by the scanX signal engine, where price growth exceeds profit growth by 419% [E39] and the stock sits at 65% of its 52-week range [E5] despite contracting annual sales [E48].
